amendments.trigger: Generic DOJ investigation synthetic case could be misclassified as antitrust.
amendments.rule: Require explicit antitrust/competition-authority/competition-regulator/monopoly language in title+slug in addition to an enforcement action.

amendments.trigger: Common title form FDA approves X was rejected.
amendments.rule: Recognize approve/approves/approval/approved and authorize/authorizes/authorization while preserving advisory/final separation.

amendments.trigger: Allowed slug words joined by hyphens could not match natural-language family regexes.
amendments.rule: Before classification only, convert hyphen and underscore separators in title+slug to spaces. No query/tag/series/source field is added.

precision_direction: No relaxation based on real v2 counts is permitted after first real v2 execution; changes then require a new protocol version.
